rule: Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; the way round follows the shore.
Open grassland and scrub. Easy going: travel on foot.
Forest without a path. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Hills and broken ground. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Marsh and fen. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.
Sand and scrub. Tough going in heat: travel by rough_terrain, and carry water.
Cold, open ground. Tough going in weather: travel by rough_terrain.
Ice and crevasses. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain, and rope up.
Ash, lava, and poisonous air. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.
Dense tropical forest. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Heath and peat. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Open grassy plain. Easy going: travel on foot.
Eroded gullies and broken rock. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Tilled fields and hedgerows. Easy going while the tracks are dry: travel on foot.
Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; a boat is needed.
Shallow coral water. Small boats may cross slowly; larger craft cannot.
An isolated shore. Easy going on the land; reaching it needs a boat.
Raised tableland. Tough going up or down the rim: travel by rough_terrain.
Mountain country. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain; passes are few.
Bog and standing water. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.
Shoreline and coastal water. Easy going along the shore; boats keep close in.
Flowing water. Cross at a ford, bridge, or boat; the banks are easy going.
Flower meadows and soft grass. Easy going on foot.
Dark conifer forest. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Sheer walls and a broken floor. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain.
Cracked white pan. Easy going when dry, but there is no water or cover.
Cold ash and cinders. Tough going, and the air stings the throat.
Calm, shallow water. Cross by boat or wade the warm shallows.
Rows of fruit trees and mown grass. Easy going between the trunks.
Wind-scoured upland. Tough going: travel by rough_terrain.
Deep, sucking bog. Perilous going: travel by rough_terrain, and test the ground.
